name: Tob
overview: The biblical references to Tob highlight it as a district in Syria, also known as Ish-Tob or Ishtob, which played a role in the historical conflicts involving Israel. Tob is first mentioned as the place where Jephthah fled and gathered followers before being called to lead against the Ammonites, indicating its function as a refuge and a base for assembling fighters. Later, Tob is identified as part of the Syrian forces allied with the Ammonites in battle against Israel, emphasizing its involvement in regional warfare. These passages illustrate Tob’s significance as both a geographic location and a source of military support in the narrative of Israel’s struggles.
